item.title: Bulletin updated at 21:15 HKT 23/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will be a few showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China tomorrow. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the following couple of days, showers will ease off gradually and high temperatures will be alleviated slightly over the region. Another trough of low pressure is expected to bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China midweek next week. The trough of low pressure will linger over the vicinity of the northern part of the South China Sea in the latter part of next week. There will still be a few showers over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with showers. Showers will be heavier in some areas with a few squally thunderstorms at first. Showers will ease off gradually later. Hot with bright periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 26 - 32 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
